chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya and others from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr said:

Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) said: "The voluntary prayer on Friday is six rak'at in the morning, and two rak'at when the sun declines, then pray the obligatory prayer, then pray after it six rak'at."
ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed number of voluntary prayers for Friday according to Imam al-Rida (AS)?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Rida (AS) in *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies a structured routine of fourteen voluntary rak'at for Friday, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the day through distinct morning and post-obligatory sessions. Scholarly tradition often links this specific count to the virtues of Friday as the 'chief of days,' reinforcing the practice of augmenting obligatory worship with consistent nafl acts to attain spiritual excellence.
